استقرئ (form X)
# اُسْتُقْرِئَ (ustuqriʔa) /us.tuq.ri.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اِسْتَقْرِئْ (istaqriʔ) /is.taq.riʔ/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
